title: Super-agent
subtitle: One always-on agent: continuous chat, parallel work, background progress

intro.heading: How is this different from regular chats?
intro.continuous: A single continuous conversation with no session list. Follow-ups never depend on remembering which chat you were in.
intro.parallel: Throw in several things in a row without waiting. Background tasks run in parallel without interfering.
intro.background: Keeps working in the tray after you close the window, and reports back here.
intro.safe: Experimental: background tasks only use read-only tools. They never modify your data or run commands.
intro.enableInSettings: Turn on Super-agent in Settings → Automation first.

empty: Say something, e.g. "organize this week's mistakes", then carry on with other things.

composer.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line. You can keep sending without waiting.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.empty: No background tasks yet. They appear here when Super-agent decides to work on something in parallel.

settings.title: Super-agent (experimental)
settings.description: An alternative to per-session chats: one continuous conversation with parallel background tasks.
settings.switchDescription: When on, a Super-agent page appears in the sidebar. When off, the entry is hidden and regular chats are unaffected.
settings.safety: Background tasks only use read-only tools; they never modify your data or run commands. Keeps working in the tray after the window is closed.
